name: Super Strong instant coffee
ingredients_raw: It's 6 AM on a balmy day. Paati is busy making VS Thatha his first frothy cup of coffee. While he savours it to the accompaniment of the newspaper, she prepares a tall flask for the entire household. Her strong and coffee-chicory blend is perfect flavorful, with no bitter aftertaste. Our mornings are punctuated by frequent doses from this beloved coffee flask. Thatha, especially, keeps coming back to it compulsively - we all loved Paati's coffee, but none more than Thatha! Now, we bring you our homebrew in an instant coffee format. Simply add this powder and sugar to a cup of hot milk, and experience the rich flavours of the fee we grew up relishing. love, he VS Mani Family.
